title: 3-stage alert transition manager with cooldown logic
description: Implement alerts/alert_manager.py to coordinate visual and auditory alert dispatching across Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3, enforcing cooldown intervals to prevent rapid repetitive alarms.
acceptanceCriteria: Coordinates alert escalation from Stage 1 (Initial) -> Stage 2 (High) -> Stage 3 (Critical)
Enforces minimum interval (cooldown) between repeated voice or tone emissions
Provides preview alert method to test any stage without triggering actual drowsiness
Logs every alert escalation and de-escalation to EventLogger
Unit tests verify cooldown throttling and preview functionality

steps.details: Create alerts/alert_manager.py with AlertManager receiving state updates and managing active_stage, last_alert_time, and cooldown_seconds.
When new state differs from current: trigger corresponding alert action, log event via EventLogger, and update stage status.
Implement preview_alert(stage: int) to simulate the audio-visual alert of Stage 1, 2, or 3 for 3 seconds.
Create tests/test_alert_manager.py verifying that state updates trigger alerts, cooldown throttles excessive repeated calls, and preview functions work.

technicalNotes: Prevent overlapping audio streams by queuing or canceling ongoing audio when a higher priority stage triggers.
Keep alert manager decoupled from specific audio drivers.
